title: Lull Whisper rollout journal
content:
Purpose: quick personal log / working plan for a small, quiet rollout of model v2.1 -> v2.2 (Lull-Whisper). Goal: surface instability early without noisy client impact; keep cost delta small; have a fast, tested escape hatch.

Background: v2.2 includes KV-cache compaction tweak + quantization profile B. Locally good, but minor regen divergence seen on ~2% of prompts in evaluation harness. Need conservative canary.

Plan sketch (high-level):
- Day -1: preflight smoke. Run housekeeper job to warm KV cache across candidate pools (script: tools/warm-kv.sh). Confirm baseline latency 95p.
- Day 0 morning (09:00 PST): route 0.5% traffic for 30m (random global cohort). Monitor 1m latency, error-rate, hallucination score (eval set), token cost.
- Escalation gates: if 95p latency +10% OR error-rate > 0.5% in 30m -> rollback immediately. If hallucination delta > 3% on eval set -> hold and expand debug cohort to 5%.
- Day 0 afternoon: if stable, increase to 2% for 2h. Then 5% for 4h. If still ok, schedule a gradual ramp to 20% overnight.

Warmup cohorts and priming notes:
- Start with fresh cohort of long-tail tenants (low SLA) to avoid noisy product impact. Use client-ids: sampled_low_traffic_2026-03. Do not include enterprise tenants until 10%+.
- Prefetch: run UX-sim prefix cache seeding for 1h against candidate pool. This reduced cold-start token spikes in blue-green canaries last month.

Pinning and compatibility:
- Endpoint config should pin model family + quant profile: model:lull-whisper@v2.2+qB. Keep fallback policy to v2.1.
- SDK toggle: feature flag ff/rollout/lull-whisper-2026. Use one-click revert in console.

Telemetry queries (placeholders):
- latency: SELECT p95, p99 FROM requests WHERE model = 'lull-whisper' AND env = 'canary' SINCE 30m
- hallucination: compare eval-run:run_id=canary-2026-03-01 vs baseline

Quick rollback checklist (dry-run before Day 0):
1) console -> routes -> set feature flag to OFF (ff/rollout/lull-whisper-2026)
2) change route to fallback model v2.1 and confirm 200 responses for smoke requests
3) revoke canary pool and drain connections
4) postmortem stub: create ticket INF-????, add timeline and telemetry snapshots

Open questions / notes to self:
- How does compaction interact with long prefix reuse for streaming sessions? Might see KV thrash -> higher p95. Add synthetic test for streaming sessions length 512 tokens.
- Need to coordinate with Dedicated infra: confirm capacity cushion for burst (reserve +20%).
- Who is primary on-call? Assign Marcos for Day 0 AM, Aisha for PM.

Short command snippets (for quick copy during rollout):
- warmup: ./tools/warm-kv.sh --model lull-whisper@v2.2 --pool canary-a --duration 60m
- flip flag: curl -X POST https://console.internal/flags/ff/rollout/lull-whisper-2026/toggle -d '{"state":"off"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'

Wrap-up items after a safe ramp:
- Bake metrics for 72h at 20% before full flip.
- Add regression cases that tripped (if any) to nightly eval harness and create a tuning task for quant profile.

Notes to file: keep this informal. I will iterate after first test and capture actual timestamps and telemetry snapshots here.

Signed: Isaac M. (personal working doc)
notes_plain: Personal working sketch for canary rollout of lull-whisper v2.2. Conservative ramps: 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% -> 20%. Strong rollback gates on latency/error/hallucination. Warmup KV cache. Keep enterprise excluded until >=10%. Primary on-call: Marcos (AM) / Aisha (PM).
